'''Gen-Goma''' was a [[Talid/Legends|Talid]] who lived on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While participating in a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] being held on his homeworld, he was injured and helped by a [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medic]]. In return, he gave the trooper and his squad valuable intelligence as to the location of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base on the planet.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />
